pack.title: Moochers & money asks
pack.description: The friend with an empty wallet and perfect timing. Keep the friend, keep the money.

scenarios.setting: Group dinner. The check lands; your friend suddenly studies the ceiling.
scenarios.jab: Just put it on your card — I'll get you back, I swear.

replies.line: Let's split it now. Cleaner for everyone.
replies.why: It proposes paying individual shares now rather than accepting another informal loan.
replies.delivery: State the actual amount only if you have checked it; keep your voice conversational.

replies.why: It proposes immediate settlement without inventing an amount.
replies.delivery: State the actual amount only if you have checked it; keep your voice conversational.

replies.line: Let's ask for a split payment so we can each cover our own share.
replies.why: It offers a practical way to preserve the agreed division of costs.
replies.delivery: State the actual amount only if you have checked it; keep your voice conversational.

replies.line: My card's retired from lending. It unionized.
replies.why: Blaming your card lets the table laugh while the point lands on him.
replies.delivery: State the actual amount only if you have checked it; keep your voice conversational.

trap.line: You ALWAYS do this. Pay your own way for once.
trap.why: It turns a payment request into a public character judgment.

scenarios.goal: Settle a shared bill at the time you agreed.

followUp.jab: Can you cover me just this once?
followUp.line: I'm not covering it tonight; let's ask how to split the payment.
followUp.why: It maintains your boundary while seeking a practical payment method.
followUp.delivery: State the actual amount only if you have checked it; keep your voice conversational.

scenarios.setting: Phone call. A friend you like owes you two hundred from spring.
scenarios.jab: Hey man, can you float me another hundred till Friday?

replies.line: I won't lend more. Let's plan repayment of what's outstanding.
replies.why: It separates the new lending decision from the repayment discussion.
replies.delivery: Keep the lending no brief, then ask about repayment without sarcasm.

replies.why: No plus the number keeps it business, not personal.
replies.delivery: Keep the lending no brief, then ask about repayment without sarcasm.

replies.line: I care about you, but I can't lend more; let's talk about settling the earlier loan.
replies.why: It preserves care while holding the financial boundary.
replies.delivery: Keep the lending no brief, then ask about repayment without sarcasm.

replies.line: My lending desk is closed; repayments are still welcome.
replies.why: The joke states a lending limit without criticizing the friend's character.
replies.delivery: Keep the lending no brief, then ask about repayment without sarcasm.

scenarios.goal: Decline another loan while one is outstanding.

followUp.jab: You know I'll pay you back eventually.
followUp.line: I won't lend more; let's agree on a plan for the amount outstanding.
followUp.why: It separates a clear lending decision from a realistic repayment discussion.
followUp.delivery: Keep the lending no brief, then ask about repayment without sarcasm.

scenarios.setting: A friend asks to borrow your expensive camera after previously returning it damaged.
scenarios.jab: Come on, you hardly use it. Let me borrow it.
scenarios.goal: Decline lending a possession without negotiating its value.

replies.line: I'm not lending the camera again.
replies.why: It states the decision without debating how often you use the camera.
replies.delivery: Use a flat ending on “not lending”; stop before listing every possible risk.

replies.line: The camera isn't available to borrow.
replies.why: It makes the lending boundary explicit and impersonal.
replies.delivery: Say “The camera isn't available to borrow” clearly, then stop instead of adding a defense. Stop before listing every possible risk.

replies.line: I know it would help; after the damage last time, I'm keeping it with me.
replies.why: It acknowledges the request while naming the relevant experience calmly.
replies.delivery: Keep “I know it would help” warm and unhurried; finish the request clearly. Stop before listing every possible risk.

replies.line: My camera has retired from guest appearances.
replies.why: Humor communicates an enduring limit without calling the friend careless.
replies.delivery: Keep “My camera has retired from guest appearances” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. Stop before listing every possible risk.

followUp.line: I hear you; I'm still not lending it.
followUp.why: It acknowledges the assurance without treating it as a reason to surrender the decision.
followUp.delivery: Use a flat ending on “not lending”; stop before listing every possible risk.
